reviews.author: Vermell Grant
reviews.text: We replaced our deck several years ago with a sunroom and needed to replace the old patio below, however had not done it. So glad we connected with Pure Concrete to finally complete the job! It turned out better than we had imagined! The workmanship is excellent! And found the cost to be reasonable. The crew completed the project in a very timely manner and kept us informed of their progress throughout the entire process. They were very considerate that we were at home while they were working.

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.text: I reached out for an estimate to Hoscar on a patio project and scheduled two confirmed appointment times. The first time, when he didn’t show up at the scheduled time, I followed up myself and was kind and flexible about rescheduling. The second time, he confirmed he would be there by 5:00 PM and never showed up or communicated at all. This was a clear waste of my time and reflects a lack of professionalism. I understand that businesses get busy- but this was a clear waste of time. Communication and reliability are basic expectations and if they didn’t want to take on the project for whatever reason, all they had to do was say that or even referred us somewhere else. I’m sure the work is good, but the lack of professionalism by Hoscar is concerning.

reviews.author: Heath Phillips
reviews.text: We recently had Pure Concrete clean and seal our walkway, and it looks brand new. We also hired them to pour the floor in our shed. Because we had additional work scheduled afterward, we needed the job done quickly, Pure Concrete had us on the schedule within two days, and the entire project was completed in just one day with excellent results. Their work was so impressive that we brought them back to pour an apron and install a drain in front of our garage. Once again, the crew was quick, clean, and delivered high-quality work. We’ll definitely be calling them again. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Leslie Fulk
reviews.text: We had our old asphalt driveway removed in Waynesboro and replaced with stamped concrete. Highly recommend these great group of guys, they finished all the work in a timely manner and couldn’t be anymore happier with it. 10/10

reviews.author: Jaimie Hensley
reviews.text: Hoscar and Pure Concrete were so easy to work with, punctual, and helpful! They did a great job and my patio was completed quickly with very little turnaround time. I love my new patio!

reviews.author: Aaron Fleming
reviews.text: Hoscar came out on a Sunday to shoot elevations with me and my wife, we had a 80x30 monolithic slab for a garage done by them. They did all the site work as well. Highly recommended. We are very pleased with our work. The guys take a lot of pride in their work.

reviews.author: Jerry Ritchie
reviews.text: I want to give a big shout out to Oscar and his helpers they did a superb job on my garage. Oscar is very good to deal with and very professional and you won't beat his price.if you need concrete pure concrete should be your first call.Thank you Oscar and when I'm in need of concrete you will be the man I call.

reviews.author: Matthew May
reviews.text: I highly recommend Pure Concrete! The whole experience from start to finish was great. Hoscar and his workers do an AMAZING job! If you need any concrete work I would definitely give Pure Concrete a call!!

reviews.author: Branson Good
reviews.text: Oscar and his crew tore out our old patio and installed a stamped concrete patio and we love it! Great service and quality work. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: John Trudell
reviews.text: Good group of contractors. Work gets done well and quickly. Worked bringing concrete to them for a while and haven't seen one job done wrong.

reviews.author: Howard Mcdonald
reviews.text: Never showed up for scheduled appointment. Called,texted tried leaving messages. No response. Hate to see his service after the sale!!! Don't recommend!!!

reviews.author: Malak Bani-Hani
reviews.text: Hoscar and his team redid our back patio and poured a pad for our deck before it was built. They were easy to work with and did a great job.

reviews.author: Kendra McLaughlin
reviews.text: EDIT: After our patio was put in back in May, we discussed with Hoscar about coming back in a couple of weeks to complete the stairs we talked about around our patio. With minimal communication to us, we finally got in touch with him and he said they would be here the first week of July. Never showed up. We have tried to contact him each day for over a week by phone, text, and email- with no response. Very disappointed with the outcome of this as we initiatally had a great experience and love our patio. Very unprofessional to not even get a response from him. Do not recommend wasting your time. We just had a patio put in at our home by Pure Concrete and had the best experience. They were so easy to work with from getting the quote, to the finished project. They completed the project in a timely manner and are even coming back to add steps, which is something we decided to add after the initial quote and plan. All for a reasonable price. The patio is gorgeous and exactly what we envisioned. Hoscar was great with communication with the status of the project. Overall, we highly recommend him and his team to complete your next project!

reviews.author: Hasan Pandzic
reviews.text: The best done few jobs for me. I am grateful I found them. Will use them for all my concrete needs. Thank you
